title: Cement vs Concrete vs Terracotta Tiles: What to Choose
excerpt: Cement, concrete and terracotta tiles compared for Pakistan: how each is made, outdoor use, upkeep and how to decide.
meta_title: Cement vs Concrete vs Terracotta Tiles: What to Choose
meta_description: Cement tiles vs concrete tiles vs terracotta in Pakistan: making, outdoor use, upkeep and choosing by use. Free sample on WhatsApp.
answer_box: Cement and concrete tiles are cured cement-based pieces, and the names are used loosely. Terracotta is clay fired in a kiln, with a warmer natural look. Choose by use: concrete for paths and driveways, terracotta for porches and floors, sealed cement for feature floors.
ai_summary: Cement and concrete tiles are moulded and cured, while terracotta is shaped and kiln-fired clay. Each suits different jobs, and base, drainage and sealing matter as much as the material. Pak Clay Tiles, in Lahore since 1982, offers a free WhatsApp sample and a dated quote.

faqs.question: What is the difference between cement tiles and concrete tiles?
faqs.answer: Both are cured cement-based pieces and the names are used loosely. Ask the seller what the tile is made of, its thickness and its intended use.

faqs.question: How much do cement, concrete and terracotta tiles cost in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Prices depend on material, thickness, size, finish, quantity, delivery, season and labour, and may be per piece or per square foot. Ask for a written quote with unit and date; Pak Clay replies with one on request.

faqs.question: Is terracotta better than cement tile?
faqs.answer: Not in general. Terracotta gives a warm natural look and needs no paint, while cement tile offers bold patterns but usually needs sealing. Compare samples for your space.

faqs.question: Which is best for outdoor floors in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Concrete otti and pavers and textured terracotta are common outdoor choices. Check grip, thickness and drainage, and test a wet sample before ordering.
